posts.title: The Delay Text on the Way to BWI
posts.desc: A Christmas ski trip to Denver, two kids in the back seat and a message that the flight had slipped to tomorrow. What United Premier 1K status actually did that day, and the rules behind each moment.
posts.imageAlt: A skier crossing a snowy slope below a mountain peak near Breckenridge, Colorado
